name: EnhancedRfcRowParserV1
row_identity: resolve Task ID by header registry, normalize surrounding spreadsheet whitespace only, then call LLD-03 exact RFC identifier parser
VALID NC+14 produces entity_kind=rfc and observed_valid_identity

a value beginning with one exact canonical NC+14 followed by additional non-whitespace source suffix characters is classified as RECOGNIZED_SOURCE_BRANCH_ARTIFACT and becomes invalid_row + RFC_SOURCE_BRANCH_ARTIFACT finding; it never resolves or mutates the base RFC
any other unusable/malformed identity becomes invalid_row + RFC_ID_INVALID finding
identityless logical row fabricates no RFC
row_chronology: usable Last Update Time becomes source_row_chronology_utc. Missing/unusable Last Update remains NULL; file mtime/import time/Create Time never substitutes. A changed accepted field with no chronology comparable to an existing accepted field is review-required rather than assumed newer.
duplicate_partition: group valid rows by canonical rfc_no after parsing

rows with identical canonical allowlisted logical field state/value sets are equivalent duplicates: preserve physical observation provenance, add duplicate warning, and generate one effective logical observation for proposal computation

rows with different meaningful allowlisted logical content for same rfc_no are conflicting source evidence: record all observations/findings and block only that RFC's proposal scope until reviewed/resolved
a conflict does not reject unrelated valid RFC identities
proposal_seeds: exact existing/manual RFC -> adoption/current source projection seed
missing exact RFC -> RFC create/adopt seed
recognized Customer account/name facts -> Customer reconciliation seed, never direct assignment
Summary -> SR-link candidate extraction seed under reconciliation algorithm
terminal recognized Status -> high-risk RFC source projection seed whose acceptance invokes LLD-03 terminal proposal creation
prohibitions: no Task/WFM creation from RFC rows
no Product Line/SLA/Infrastructure inference from deferred/discarded fields
